title: CatalogEntry
description: The catalog entry containing detailed package metadata for a specific version.

@id.description: The URL to the document used to produce this object.

authors.description: The author or authors of the package.

dependencyGroups.description: The dependencies of the package, grouped by target framework.

iconUrl.description: The URL to the package icon.

licenseUrl.description: The URL to the package license.

listed.description: Whether the package is listed. Considered listed if absent.

minClientVersion.description: The minimum NuGet client version required to use this package.

packageContent.description: The URL to the package content (.nupkg). Included for legacy compatibility.

projectUrl.description: The URL to the project page.

published.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp of when the package was published.

readmeUrl.description: A URL for the rendered view of the package README.

requireLicenseAcceptance.description: Whether the package requires license acceptance before installation.

version.description: The full version string after normalization, which may include SemVer 2.0.0 build metadata.

vulnerabilities.description: Security vulnerabilities associated with this package version.
